Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
VDI & End User Support Specialist
 🌍 Location: Eastern Europe preferred (other locations may be considered)
 🗣️ Language: English C1 (mandatory)
 🛡️ Nationality: NATO nationality mandatory
 🔒 Security Clearance: PSC required (active PSC is a strong advantage)
 About the Role
 We are looking for a VDI & End User Support Specialist to join an international IT operations team supporting secure and mission-critical environments. The ideal candidate will have experience providing technical support across virtual desktop infrastructures, endpoint devices, collaboration tools, and on-site user support services.
 Key Responsibilities
Provide support and administration for VDI (Virtual Desktop Infrastructure) environments.
Support and troubleshoot secure desktop solutions and endpoint devices.
Manage user issues related to NextCloud collaboration tools, file sharing, and productivity services.
Deliver Service Desk support, ensuring timely incident resolution and excellent customer service.
Provide Site Support for hardware, software, and workplace technology issues.
Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, mobile devices, and peripherals.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve technical incidents following ITSM best practices.
Create and maintain technical documentation and knowledge base articles.
Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and operations teams to ensure service availability and compliance.
 Required Skills & Experience
 ✅ Experience supporting VDI environments (Citrix, VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, or similar)
 ✅ Experience with secure desktop and endpoint management solutions
 ✅ Knowledge of NextCloud or similar collaboration platforms
 ✅ Strong background in Service Desk and End User Support activities
 ✅ Hardware and software troubleshooting experience
 ✅ Familiarity with ITSM processes and ticketing systems
 ✅ Excellent communication skills in English (C1+) 
 Mandatory Requirements
NATO nationality
English C1 or higher
Eligibility to obtain PSC security clearance
 Nice to Have
Active PSC Security Clearance
ITIL Foundation certification
Experience in defense, government, or highly secure environments
Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, or endpoint management certifications
 What We Offer
Opportunity to work within an international and highly secure environment
Long-term project with cutting-edge technologies
Professional growth and certification opportunities
Competitive compensation package
